CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates), an explicit organization/access field (origin), and a separate status distinction are present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (color-labeled coordinate sets) and attributes (positions) with timestamps.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are presented separately from an explicit origin/status field for the same referent/time, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates are organized/presented (grid orientation) and includes explicit origin/access metadata for specific contents.
